sources.entry: cc-thinking-skills by tjboudreaux - A collection of installable thinking-framework skills with a meta-router, notable for publishing a replication-gated evaluation instead of unsupported quality claims.

summary.one_liner: A catalog of 28 installable Agent Skills that give coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, Cursor and similar) structured thinking procedures, with a meta-router that picks the right one.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides 28 portable Agent Skills, each a SKILL.md procedure for a specific reasoning mechanism such as scientific-method debugging, pre-mortems, reversibility classification, theory of constraints, and OODA. A thinking-model-router skill chooses NONE, one frame, or up to three complementary frames for a given problem, and thinking-model-combination sequences distinct models. Skills are grouped into routing, diagnosis, decision and evaluation, creation, and risk and execution categories. They can be installed via the skills CLI, as a Claude Code plugin, or by copying the skills directory from a clone. The repo also includes validation scripts, structural and routing evaluation harnesses, and an evidence registry with an audit. The README says the evidence supports structured procedures rather than a guaranteed accuracy gain.
use_cases: Structure a debugging session with hypothesis testing
Stress-test a launch or project plan for failure modes
Classify whether an architecture decision is easy to reverse
Find the binding bottleneck in a process or system
Compare options against must-have and want criteria
Prepare an authorized red-team review of an attack surface
Size safety buffers in a plan or budget
how_to_run: git clone the repo and copy skills/* into .agents/skills/ or .claude/skills/
stack: Agent Skills (SKILL.md with YAML front matter)
notable: Publishes a replication-gated evaluation and audit rather than unsupported accuracy claims
Meta-router skill that returns NONE, one skill, or up to three complementary skills
Portable across several agent tools, not only Claude Code
Includes structural, routing, and outcome eval harnesses plus an evidence registry
Each skill includes a precise trigger, a non-trigger boundary, a procedure, and checks
caveats: README states the evidence supports structured procedures, not a guaranteed accuracy gain
The one provisional result (+4.0 points for thinking-scientific-method) is below the +5-point utility margin and has evidence gaps, per the README
All 28 skills are listed as manual-only, and the audit reports no automatic-retain verdict
Routing evaluation requires an authenticated droid CLI
keywords: help my agent think through a decision
